init.title: Gardena Smart System options
init.description: The Start button on the lawn mower entity. Resume schedule keeps the current behaviour. Mow now starts immediately for the duration below. Resuming the schedule stays available with the start_automatic service.

data_description.start_mowing_behavior: Resume schedule does nothing outside the mowing calendar. Mow now starts the mower immediately.
data_description.mow_now_duration: Seconds, multiple of 60. Used only when Start is set to mow now. Default is 10800 (3 hours).
